components.name: Pinned Action Tab
components.description: Primary conversion action, rendered as a fired-clay tab fastened with brass.
components.html: Start a conversation
components.css: .ds-action-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.1rem 3rem 1.1rem 1.4rem; color: var(--paper, #f2eddf); background: var(--clay, #b85631); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(15,20,17,.22); font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-action-tab:hover { background: var(--clay-dark, #8f3b20); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-action-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper, #f2eddf); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action-tab:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-action-pin { position: absolute; right: .8rem; top: .7rem; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #dfc97c 0 10%, #b18a3e 28%, #604412 72%); box-shadow: 1px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Warm-paper navigation with a compressed wordmark, quiet links, and one pinned action.
components.html: Greenwood HomesPortfolioApproachTeam
components.css: .ds-masthead { min-height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--ink, #18231f); background: var(--paper, #f2eddf); box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(8,12,10,.22); font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 2.25rem; color: inherit; font-family: var(--display, sans-serif); font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2.2rem; padding: 0 2.5rem; } .ds-nav-links a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible, .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--clay, #b85631); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Proof Index Leaf
components.description: A narrow vertical evidence tab with paper tone, brass fastener, index, and active state.
components.css: .ds-proof-tab { position: relative; width: 52px; min-height: 300px; padding: 3.5rem .4rem 1rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgba(24,35,31,.15); color: var(--ink, #18231f); background: var(--paper, #f2eddf); box-shadow: 3px 3px 10px rgba(24,35,31,.12); cursor: pointer; writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; transition: background .2s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-proof-tab:hover { background: #fff9ec; transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-proof-tab:focus-visible { background: #fff9ec; outline: 3px solid var(--clay, #b85631); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-proof-tab[aria-selected="true"] { width: 68px; color: var(--clay-dark, #8f3b20); background: var(--paper, #f2eddf); } .ds-proof-tab small { position: absolute; top: 2.5rem; writing-mode: horizontal-tb; } .ds-proof-pin { position: absolute; top: 1rem; left: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #dfc97c 0 10%, #a67d2e 35%, #583d0e 78%); box-shadow: 1px 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.42); }

components.name: Proof Sheet
components.description: The active evidence record: proposition, verified fact, explanation, and drafting detail.
components.html:
Proof 01 / 07

Built on a long record.

Since 1998

A licensed general contractor with regional offices.
components.css: .ds-proof-sheet { position: relative; width: 300px; min-height: 500px; padding: 3rem 2.2rem; color: var(--ink, #18231f); background: rgba(242,237,223,.94); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(7,11,9,.2); font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); } .ds-proof-sheet h3 { max-width: 10ch; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-family: var(--display, sans-serif); font-size: 2.3rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: .95; } .ds-proof-sheet strong { display: block; margin-bottom: .75rem; color: var(--clay-dark, #8f3b20); font-family: var(--display, sans-serif); font-size: 1.35rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-proof-sheet p:last-of-type { line-height: 1.4; } .ds-proof-count { margin: 0 0 1.8rem; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-pin { position: absolute; top: 1.1rem; left: 1.2rem; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #dfc97c 0 10%, #b18a3e 28%, #604412 72%); box-shadow: 1px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-drafting-lines { height: 130px; margin-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(24,35,31,.24); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 24px, rgba(24,35,31,.2) 24px 25px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 32px, rgba(24,35,31,.2) 32px 33px); } .ds-proof-sheet:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(7,11,9,.24); } .ds-proof-sheet:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--clay, #b85631); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Testimony Record
components.description: A broad ruled-paper quotation sheet pinned above the portfolio.
components.css: .ds-testimony { margin: 0; padding: 2rem 4rem; color: var(--ink, #18231f); background-color: var(--paper, #f2eddf); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(24,35,31,.035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 100% 29px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(7,11,9,.2); font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); } .ds-testimony blockquote { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; max-width: 24ch; font-family: var(--display, sans-serif); font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-testimony blockquote::first-letter { color: var(--clay, #b85631); } .ds-testimony a { color: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-underline-offset: .3rem; } .ds-testimony a:hover { color: var(--clay-dark, #8f3b20); } .ds-testimony a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--clay, #b85631); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Portrait Print
components.description: Square, slightly desaturated team portrait mounted on warm paper with a role notation.
components.css: .ds-portrait { width: 240px; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #18231f); background: var(--paper, #f2eddf); box-shadow: 0 13px 25px rgba(24,35,31,.2); transform: rotate(-2deg); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-portrait:hover { transform: rotate(0) translateY(-3px); } .ds-portrait:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--clay, #b85631); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-portrait-image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--paper-deep, #d5c5a2), var(--ink-soft, #344039)); filter: saturate(.78); } .ds-portrait figcaption { padding: 1rem; font-family: var(--display, sans-serif); font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-portrait figcaption span { display: block; margin-top: .35rem; color: var(--clay-dark, #8f3b20); font-family: var(--body, sans-serif); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Greenwood Homes presents trust as something a visitor can inspect. Monumental completed-work photography carries desire, while warm paper, vellum-like proof leaves, precise rules, construction notation, and pinned action tabs turn verified experience into a tactile record rather than generic luxury marketing.

The visual world is assured, practical, and quietly crafted. Charcoal drafting linen establishes weight; warm paper creates legibility and human warmth; fired clay reserves attention for action and proof; brass appears only where an object is physically “fastened.” The layout stays editorial and open even when evidence is dense.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence is layered directly over completed work.
Square paper planes, fine rules, and countable drafting marks replace generic cards.
Compressed display type carries architectural weight; humanist sans-serif copy stays calm and readable.
Warm material color and restrained motion make the interface tactile without becoming nostalgic or ornamental.
Photography remains full-color, site-specific, and visually dominant.

rules.name: The Fired-Clay Signal Rule
rules.body: Fired clay marks action, active proof, or direct emphasis; it does not become general decoration.

rules.name: The Brass Fastener Rule
rules.body: Brass belongs to literal pins and fastening details only.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed states the proposition; Source Sans 3 explains the evidence.

rules.name: The Notation Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is reserved for short indexes, measurements, roles, and locations—never paragraphs.

rules.name: The Open Worktable Rule
rules.body: Preserve breathing room around evidence clusters; density belongs inside the proof record, not across the whole page.

rules.name: The Image-and-Record Rule
rules.body: Major photographic fields should touch or overlap a paper record so aspiration and proof remain visibly connected.

rules.name: The Physical Stack Rule
rules.body: Use elevation only when one material plane visibly sits above another.

rules.name: The No Rounded Card Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces stay square; a circular silhouette means a fastener, not a container.

dos: Do pair major claims with completed-work imagery or a specific proof record.
Do keep paper planes square, rules fine, and shadows low and offset.
Do reserve fired clay for actions, active evidence, focus, and short emphasis.
Do keep completed-home and team photography full-color, site-specific, and prominent.
Do convert the proof index into horizontal, always-readable controls on mobile.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences for sheet changes, image scaling, and smooth scrolling.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill controls, glossy glass panels, or soft SaaS-style containers.
Don't scatter brass as decoration; it represents a physical pin or fastener.
Don't let uppercase notation expand into long-form copy.
Don't separate aspiration from evidence with a generic luxury-gallery hero.
Don't introduce sidebar navigation or sideways headline text on compact screens.
Don't fabricate technical plans; drafting drawings are precise visual metaphors, not engineering documents.
